subject: general
question: Which state government will launch the ‘No Helmet, No Fuel’ road safety campaign in September 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Uttar Pradesh government will launch a special state-wide road safety campaign ‘No Helmet, No Fuel’ from September 1 to 30, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The campaign is aimed at promoting the use of helmets to save lives on roads.**
 
• **A directive has been issued to ensure coordinated efforts under the supervision of district magistrates.**
 
• **District Road Safety Committees (DRSCs) will play a key role in execution.**
 
• **Police, revenue officials, and the transport department will lead the enforcement of the initiative.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• No Helmet, No Fuel Campaign__

 __
 
• A strict enforcement campaign to ensure riders wear helmets before being allowed to refuel.
 
• Seeks to instill road discipline and reduce fatalities due to head injuries in accidents.
 
 
 
• Role of DRSCs__
 __
 
• District Road Safety Committees will monitor implementation at the local level.
 
• District magistrates will oversee coordination among departments.
 
 
 
• Other Departments Involved__
 
 
• Police for enforcement on ground.
 
• Revenue and Transport departments for administrative support.
